verdict.rationale: Orb's own documented features include several configurable processes that run in the background without intervention: automatic invoice issuance after grace periods, automatic dunning retries on a fixed schedule, managed daily exports, usage-threshold alerts and automatic top-ups. These are fixed, billing-specific behaviors, not a general way for users to define their own autonomous automations or agent runs; the MCP server only serves agents acting on request. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation or workflow builder, user-defined triggers and actions beyond built-in billing behaviors, scheduled or recurring agent tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
